Name: Cozy Hilltop Farm (REUPLOADED)
Author: Novamare
Description:
[size=4][center][b]~ Features ~[/b][/center][/size][center]- Replaces the Hilltop farm (configurable) to appear more aesthetic, but keeps the same original layout
- Adds a waterfall next to grandpa's shrine
- Replaces the wood planks with stone bridges
- Replaces the dirt with Tillable grass
[b]It is possible to replace an existing Hilltop save with this farm map since it does not change the original layout.[/b]


[size=4][b]~ Requirements ~[/b][/size]
- [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets
[/url]- ﻿[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]- [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI


[/url][size=4][b]~ Installation ~[/b][/size]
1. Download the Mod/Required Mods, and extract them
2. Paste it into your \Stardew Valley\mods\ folder﻿﻿﻿
3. Run the game and enjoy


[size=4][b]~ Config Options ~[/b][/size]
MapToReplace:
- Standard
- Foraging
- Fishing
- Mining
- Combat
